subject.title: Silent empty tool results in long-running Sonnet 5 sessions after a large tool result

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99524 be treated as the canonical fix path for this issue after it is refreshed, or should this issue require separate installed long-session provider payload proof before closure?
rationale: The source gap and new multi-provider reports strongly match the open PR, but this issue's exact production trigger has not been proven against that PR in an installed session.

options.title: Canonicalize on the prompt-projection PR
options.body: Treat the open PR as the repair path, refresh it against main, and close this issue only after the fix lands with main or release proof plus targeted payload validation.

options.title: Require separate provider payload proof
options.body: Keep this issue as a distinct tracker until a sanitized failing and after-fix provider request comparison proves the candidate PR covers this report.

recommendation.title: Canonicalize on the prompt-projection PR
recommendation.body: Treat the open PR as the repair path, refresh it against main, and close this issue only after the fix lands with main or release proof plus targeted payload validation.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent same-helper fresh-result protection and are the best history-backed owner for the prompt-recovery tradeoff.
